description: This file defines structures, functions, and constants for handling OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) responses, including parsing, revocation status checking, and request creation, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: OCSPCertID
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded RFC 6960 CertID used in OCSP requests and responses.

classes.name: OCSPCertStatus
classes.description: Represents the revocation status of a certificate, including reason and revocation time.

classes.name: OCSPSingleResponse
classes.description: Represents a single response within an OCSP response, including status and update times.

classes.name: OCSPResponseData
classes.description: Contains the response data from an OCSP response, including responder ID and responses.

classes.name: OCSPResponse
classes.description: Represents the entire OCSP response, including status, signature, and embedded certificates.

methods.name: ParseOCSPCertID
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CertID from an input buffer.

methods.name: ParseOCSPSingleResponse
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded SingleResponse from an input buffer.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponseData
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded ResponseData from an input buffer.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded OCSPResponse from an input buffer.

methods.name: CheckOCSP
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate using a DER-encoded OCSP response.

methods.name: CreateOCSPRequest
methods.description: Creates a DER-encoded OCSP request for a given certificate.

methods.name: CreateOCSPGetURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for an OCSP GET request for a certificate.
